model.title: National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2027
model.meta: Armed Services Committee · Sen. Roger Wicker (R-MS)

summary.text: The bill would set policy and spending authority for the Department of Defense and the nuclear security programs of the Department of Energy for fiscal year 2027. It would cover several main areas: authorizing purchases of equipment such as aircraft and ships, setting troop strength levels for active and reserve forces, and setting rules for military health care and pay. It would also address defense contracting, relations with foreign nations including the Middle East, Europe, and the Indo-Pacific, and cyber operations, cybersecurity, and artificial intelligence. In addition, it would require a review of certain industrial materials critical to defense and let a Pentagon office make equity investments in some battery and critical mineral projects, while authorizing specific military construction projects and the nuclear security agencies.
